newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: San Jose says shareholders to sell stake.
newsitem.headline: San Jose says shareholders to sell stake.

text.p: San Jose Oil Co Inc said on Monday three of its major shareholders have entered into an agreement with three real estate firms to sell their combined 10,501,786,449 shares in the firm.

The company said in a statement businessman Alfredo Ramos, National Bookstore Inc and Alakor Corp have forged an agreement with Summit Realty and Development Corp, St Benedict Realty and Development Corp and Tussle Realty Development Corp to sell their shares.
San Jose did not say what percentage of the company's total shareholding was involved in the sale.
The sale will be done through a block sale at the Philippine Stock Exchange today or on such later date as may be mutually agreed by both parties.
The oil exploration firm said it plans to reorganise its board, to reflect the change of ownership, after the block sale.
San Jose Oil also plans to convert into a holding firm from an oil and mining company and to increase its authorised capital from 300 million pesos to two billion pesos.
Par value of the shares of the firm would also be increased to one peso each from the present one centavo.
